draft.emotion: thirst being quenched, satisfied and refreshed
notes: In Chinese, 喝 is also used for soup: 喝汤 (hē tāng, to eat/have soup).
Do not confuse 喝 (hē, with 口 'mouth' on the left) with the similar-looking 渴 (kě, with 氵 'water' on the left), which means 'thirsty'.
